text: A C^1 vector field F on a simply connected region is conservative if and only if:
choices: it is a unit vector field
explanation: On a simply connected domain, curl-free (curl F = 0) is equivalent to conservative (F = grad phi). Divergence-free means solenoidal/incompressible, a different condition. Simple connectivity is essential: on a punctured plane a curl-free field can fail to be conservative.
